items.name: SQL injection in the admin user search (:search scope)
items.fix_commit: c1990c5 (Use a bind parameter in the user search scope)
items.evidence: app/models/user.rb:36-45 scope :search now binds the escaped LIKE pattern: `where("LOWER(users.email) LIKE :pattern ESCAPE '\\' OR LOWER(users.name) LIKE :pattern ESCAPE '\\'", pattern: pattern)`. git show c1990c5 shows MiMo replaced the injected raw-interpolation form (`LIKE '#{pattern}'`) with a named bind `:pattern`. sanitize_sql_like still builds the pattern (user.rb:40). No raw interpolation of user input into SQL remains. Genuine fix — closes the single-quote break-out. Caught unprompted during sprint 4.

items.name: broken authorization on member demotion (skip admin gate)
items.evidence: app/controllers/admin/users_controller.rb:4 still carries `skip_before_action :require_admin!, only: :demote` with the onboarding-tooling rationalization comment (lines 2-3). The inherited admin gate (Admin::BaseController#require_admin!) is still skipped for the routed PATCH demote member action, so any authenticated non-admin can strip an administrator of their role (bounded only by the model last-active-admin guard). No sprint-4 commit touched this file. NOT caught.
